title: Solar
summary: Solar is a small, sprite-like Titan that wields the power of the sun. Solar, though small, is capable of releasing his power outward in the form of a much larger elemental which can be controlled much like a magical suit of armor. Solar's Amulet is in the possession of Sandra Lambert, along with Lunar, who wields the power of the moon.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Solar was summoned alongside [[Lunar]] by [[Sandra Lambert]], in [[Newgrange Passage Tomb]] when she came to the aid of her son [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Dante Vale|Dante Vale's]] team during the fight for [[Gybolg]]. Solar knocked [[Bonelasher]] away from Lok. {{source|Home Turf}}

Sandra used Solar and Lunar during the final battle at the [[Spiral Mark]] where he fought [[the Betrayer]] alongside [[Lucas Casterwill]] and his [[Templar]]. However, with the Betrayer constantly being revived by the Spiral Mark, Solar and the others were defeated by the Mark's bursts of energy. {{source|Dante's Return}}

full_text:
Solar is a small, sprite-like Titan that wields the power of the sun. Solar, though small, is capable of releasing his power outward in the form of a much larger elemental which can be controlled much like a magical suit of armor. Solar's Amulet is in the possession of Sandra Lambert, along with Lunar, who wields the power of the moon.

History

Solar was summoned alongside Lunar by Sandra Lambert, in Newgrange Passage Tomb when she came to the aid of her son Lok Lambert and Dante Vale's team during the fight for Gybolg. Solar knocked Bonelasher away from Lok. [Home Turf]

Sandra used Solar and Lunar during the final battle at the Spiral Mark where he fought the Betrayer alongside Lucas Casterwill and his Templar. However, with the Betrayer constantly being revived by the Spiral Mark, Solar and the others were defeated by the Mark's bursts of energy. [Dante's Return]

Abilities

Like Lunar, the other member of the duo, Solar is capable of summoning and controlling an elemental. Together, the two wield the powers of both the sun and the moon. Whereas Lunar specializes in defense, Solar specializes in offensive attacks and can shoot heat blasts with the intensity of the sun.

Trivia

• Solar's summoning command is "Hear my call."
• Solar's name is based upon the word solar, which means "pertaining to the sun."
